name: Cold chain · daily report
description: Emails and saves the daily cold-chain record.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'flux', dialect: { header: true, annotations: [] }, query: 'data = from(bucket: ' + JSON.stringify($env.INFLUXDB_BUCKET) + ')
  |> range(start: ' + $('Period').first().json.start + ', stop: ' + $('Period').first().json.stop + ')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_data" and r.sensor == "temperature" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device"])
union(tables: [
  data |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: min, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "stat", value: "min"),
  data |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "stat", value: "max"),
  data |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "stat", value: "mean"),
])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "device"], columnKey: ["stat"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'flux', dialect: { header: true, annotations: [] }, query: 'from(bucket: ' + JSON.stringify($env.INFLUXDB_BUCKET) + ')
  |> range(start: ' + $('Period').first().json.lookback + ', stop: ' + $('Period').first().json.stop + ')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "coldchain_event")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "device", "excursion", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()' }) }}

parameters.content:
## Daily cold-chain record
At 07:00 (`GENERIC_TIMEZONE`), reports on the previous day: per unit the min, max and mean, minutes out of range and without data, and each excursion with who acknowledged it and the corrective action. Saved to `ai/data/reports/` (CSV + HTML) and emailed to `REPORT_EMAIL_TO`.

`GET /webhook/coldchain/report?date=YYYY-MM-DD` (or `?date=today`) runs it now.
